description: React component for rendering code blocks with syntax highlighting, copy-to-clipboard functionality, and customizable styling.

classes.name: CodeBlockFallback
classes.description: Fallback component for displaying code as plain text when syntax highlighting is disabled or fails.

classes.name: CodeBlockItem
classes.description: Component representing a styled code block item with optional line numbers.

classes.name: CodeBlockContent
classes.description: Component that renders syntax-highlighted code or fallback if highlighting is disabled or fails.

classes.description: Component displaying the language label and copy button for a code block.
